A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a retrieval for the HDO and H  2 O total columns from TROPOM I observations that is ready to be used operationally.
we have shown the feasibility to retrieve total column δD from TROPOM I shortwave infrared measurements with a precision of 15–25‰.

the retrieval of HDO and H  ∕ H 2 O from TROPOM I is possible with a single measurement precision of  ∼  20 ‰ for δD and 0.2–0.4 ‰ for δ 18 O, but that the retrieval is sensitive to remaining cloud or aerosol contamination and to the a prior assumptions on trace gas profiles.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the retrieval is robust and that the measurement noise is the main limiting factor in the retrieval precision.
it is possible to retrieve the isotopologue ratio from TROPOM I observations with a precision that is better than 25 ‰, and that the retrieval can be performed operationally in near real time.
it will be feasible to retrieve HDO from TROPOM I shortwave measurements, with the caveat of the need for an accurate aerosol correction.
